annotation_policy: v86 cumulative native-pixel evidence audit. v81 three-point and v82 free-throw semicircle corrections are preserved. The two lane-boundary evidence families are re-audited against the immutable native Frame C using local cross-line RGB profiles and full-resolution visual verification. Samples are moved only to the visible painted-stripe centre; no solver residuals, cross-camera transfer, player/ball geometry or generated pixels are used. One lane_positive_y sample at [612,363] is removed because the regulation stripe is occluded by a player at that pixel and therefore is not observable.

regulation_geometry.coordinate_system: backboard face x=0; +x into court; y=0 basket centre; floor z=0
regulation_geometry.note: Solver must apply the v83 NBA 2-inch painted-line centre convention: outside dimensions minus 1 inch for zero-width line-centre loci.

seed_only_correspondences.note: Approximate lane corners initialize the nonlinear solver only; excluded from all residuals and gates.

evidence_correction_v86.scope: lane boundaries only; all v81/v82 corrections preserved

lane_negative_y.image_evidence: At increasing x, the stored samples drift from the visible cyan stripe into the timber. The [435,274] sample is unambiguously on timber; the stripe centre is approximately y=279.

removed_observation.reason: player occlusion covers the lane stripe at this x; no source-visible paint centre can be annotated

lane_positive_y.held_out_mapping_note: Original held-out source indices 1,4,7 map to corrected-list indices 1,4,6 after removal of original training index 5.

evidence_correction_v86.placement_method: native RGB transition/stripe-centre audit plus visual verification; independent of solver output

notes: v86 is discovery evidence only until strict robustness is rerun. The NBA 2-inch line-width world-centre correction from v83/v84 remains required when solving this evidence.
